reguloj.name: semantic-colors-alias-palette
reguloj.statement: Semantic color tokens reference palette tokens instead of literal values.
reguloj.kialo: A palette change then reaches every semantic use in one place.

reguloj.name: dimensio-sets-alias-only
reguloj.statement: Generic Dimensio sets only re-point role tokens with aliases.
reguloj.kialo: They outrank every Aspekto; a literal or a re-pointed primitive would reach every brand.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: sets without an aspekto condition
